source.implements: "Once per …" limits shown on the ability row
tick boxes: how many uses a rule allows per battle ("once"/"twice"/"three times per battle") and whether they are counted per army or for each unit
tick boxes on an ability row: one set per army, or one per unit copy
"Granted by": which ability, detachment rule or army rule a marked value names
"Granted by": a value or keyword that a rule of the list already changed (from BSData's modifiers, checked against New Recruit's "(…)" marks): the rule's text, and that the value shown includes it

Before the battle: Warlord, enhancements, attached units, strategic reserves (20.01: at most half the points limit; 20.03: from battle round 2, destroyed at the end of round 3), Deep Strike, transports, Scouts, start of round 1 / every round, once-per-battle items
